//: Foundation adherence lint — ported from TOMS DS _adherence.oxlintrc.json, adapted to foundation. Catches off-token values in artifact-design prototypes authored as JS/TS/JSX/TSX. Extend it from the requirements space: { "extends": ["node_modules/@cloud/foundation/.oxlintrc.json"] }. NOTE: oxlint parses JS/TS, not raw .html — it sees string literals (className strings, styled values, inline-style objects), so it does NOT catch hardcoded values inside an .html <style> block. For pure static-HTML artifacts the same three rules apply by review (see governance/enforcement.md). Allowed-token registry: dist/adherence.tokens.json (generated from tokens/, run pnpm build).

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a foundation color token via var(--color-…). See governance/principles.md §1.
Raw px value — snap to a foundation scale token via var() (--space-*, --text-*, --radius-*, --spacing-control-*). 1px hairline borders are exempt. See governance/principles.md §1 & §4.
Font not in the foundation. Use var(--font-sans) / var(--font-mono) (Geist · Geist Mono).
